response.sql: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT si."healtheval" AS status, SUM(sc."scancount") AS total_scans, AVG(sc."gbsize" / NULLIF(sc."spanmin", 0)) AS average_gb_per_minute FROM "scans" sc JOIN "sites" si ON sc."zoneref" = si."zoneregistry" WHERE sc."chronotag" >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND sc."chronotag" <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY si."healtheval"), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_gb_per_minute) AS mean_status_average FROM status_averages HAVING AVG(average_gb_per_minute) IS NOT NULL) SELECT s.status, s.total_scans, s.average_gb_per_minute, s.average_gb_per_minute - o.mean_status_average AS difference_from_mean FROM status_averages s CROSS JOIN overall o

assumptions.assumption: Rows with zero scan duration have an undefined size-per-minute ratio and are excluded from the ratio averages.
